## Four-Armed Gargoyle (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
 CE Medium monstrous humanoid (earth)  
 **Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +9  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +4 natural)  
 **hp** 57 (6d10+24)  
 **Fort** +6; **Ref** +7; **Will** +5  
 **DR** 10/magic  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 60 ft. (average)  
 **Melee** 4 claws +8 (1d6+2), bite +8 (1d6+2), gore +8 (1d6+2)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 15, **Dex** 14, **Con** 18, **Int** 6, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 7  
 **Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +8; **CMD** 20  
 **Feats** Hover, Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Fly)  
 **Skills** Fly +12, Perception +9, Stealth +11 (+15 stony environs); **Racial Modifiers** +2 Perception, Stealth (+6 Stealth in stony environs)  
 **Languages** Common, Terran  
 **SQ** freeze  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Freeze (Ex)** A four-armed gargoyle can hold itself so still it appears to be a statue. A gargoyle that uses freeze can take 20 on its Stealth check to hide in plain sight as a stone statue.  
 


**Ecology**

 
**Environment** any land, aquatic, and underground  
 **Organization** solitary, pair, or wing (5–16)  
 **Treasure** standard
